citations.quote: The woman’s son, Ronn Tristan Perez, who is a Filipino-American reality television star based in the United States, arrived at the NBI’s Homicide Division on Thursday to seek the investigation into the death of his mother.

Jonathan Cellona, ABS-CBN News MAYNILA — Nanawagan ng imbestigasyon sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) ang Filipino-American TV personality na si Ronn Tristan Perez, anak ng Filipina na namatay pitong araw matapos sumailalim sa apat na cosmetic procedures sa Pilipinas noong March 2, 2026.
Ayon kay Perez, gusto niya lamang malaman ang totoong nangyari sa kanyang ina at makuha ang mga dokumentong magpapatunay kung nasunod ang lahat ng kinakailangang medical procedures at protocols.
“I just want all the documents that support that they did everything that they were supposed to,” ani Perez.
“I just need clarity. I need more than, that’s basically all I got when I got here is, ‘hey, it happens,’ that’s not good enough for me,” ani Perez.
Giit ni Perez, ang tanging hangad niya ay malaman ang katotohanan sa pagkamatay ng kanyang ina at makasiguro na hindi na mauulit sa ibang pasyente ang sinapit nito.
Giit niya, hindi siya direktang nag-aakusa, ngunit gusto niyang makuha ang kasagutan na hinihiling ng kanilang pamilya.

citations.quote: He seeks the bureau’s help to investigate his mother’s death after undergoing plastic surgeries performed by a celebrity surgeon.

MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) was tapped to look into the death of a woman who supposedly died after undergoing plastic surgery procedures performed by a celebrity plastic surgeon in San Juan City.

The woman’s son, Ronn Tristan Perez, who is a Filipino-American reality television star based in the United States, arrived at the NBI’s Homicide Division on Thursday to seek the investigation into the death of his mother.
In an interview with reporters, Perez said his mother underwent four cosmetic procedures — such as liposuction, Brazilian butt lift, tummy tuck, and body tite for arms — on March 2.
According to Perez, his mother started becoming pale after undergoing the four plastic surgery procedures at the celebrity surgeon’s clinic.
